title: Townsend Brown in the Bahamas with William Stephenson

tellings.quote: He also spent an inordinate amount of time in the Bahamas with the inspiration for James Bond and Winston Churchill super spy William Stephenson.

plain: The American researcher Thomas Townsend Brown spent what Michels calls an inordinate amount of time in the Bahamas with William Stephenson, the spy who worked for Winston Churchill and is said to have inspired James Bond. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, as a hint that Brown's work moved in intelligence circles.
